Say hello

Meet the heroes
of Trash Dash.

Two friends. One growing mess.
A little courage goes a long way.

Trash Dash follows a curious raccoon and his chaotic best friend as they trace a spreading pollution problem from their home in the woods toward a much bigger mystery.

The heart of the adventure

Chapter one characters

The hero · The heart of the adventure

Trashy

Thoughtful, curious, clever, brave, humble, and just a little mischievous. Trashy sees value where others see nothing, and he respects the things people throw away.

He is not fearless. He is brave because he keeps going while afraid. When something is wrong in the woods, Trashy follows the trail because he cannot leave his neighbors to deal with it alone.

What drives him Find where the pollution is coming from and protect the home he loves.

The chaos · The wildcard · The best friend

Jimothy

Unpredictable, enthusiastic, fearless, curious, loyal, and strange. Jimothy is not dumb; he simply values curiosity over caution, which makes every discovery an adventure of its own.

He speaks quickly and acts on impulse. Sometimes he says the wrong thing at exactly the wrong time. Every so often, he says something unexpectedly insightful—and he always contributes.

What drives him Follow Trashy wherever the trail leads, find something interesting, and see what happens next.

Trash Dash is in development. The world—and the mess—will keep growing.
